critique.evidence: The dark grid, restrained cyan/red/yellow accents, oversized headline, monospaced labels, bordered panels, and opposing red/blue zones create a cohesive and polished defense-lab identity. Desktop has strong hierarchy and an effective central arena composition. However, responsive polish falls short of demo-ready: the tablet’s fixed navigation visibly overlays the chart and clips its menu, while the vaccination cards remain squeezed into a horizontal row with awkward wrapping. On mobile, chart labels and much supporting copy are extremely small, the graph becomes nearly illegible, long mutation names form dense blocks, and the stacked page loses some of the desktop’s visual rhythm. Several low-contrast gray labels are difficult to scan against the near-black background.
critique.fix: Prevent the tablet navigation from covering content and replace clipped links with a compact menu. Reflow vaccination stages into 2–3 columns on tablet rather than compressing five cards. On mobile, increase minimum type sizes and contrast, simplify or enlarge the chart, add more spacing around dense mutation rows, and strengthen section-heading hierarchy while preserving the strong red/blue visual system.
